title: Dental Surgeon; Ayurveda Physician; Homeopathic Physician; Scientist 'B'
qualification: A recognised Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948). || OR a recognised Dental qualification granted by an authority or institution outside India, only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948. || OR a citizen of India with a foreign qualification who has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f. 13.08.2009. || Candidates who have not completed CRI (compulsory rotating internship) may appear for selection, but if selected must complete it satisfactorily before appointment.
salary: For the Ayurveda and Homeopathic Physician posts, private practice of any kind is prohibited, for which non-practicing allowance (NPA) is allowed. The notice prints no rupee amount.
age_limit: The age limit differs by post. The age limit shown is the normal limit for EWS/UR candidates and the relaxed limit for SC/OBC candidates where printed. The age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. The notice sets the closing date for online applications as the date for determining eligibility; for Scientist 'B' age and similar conditions, the original closing date 03.07.2026 prevails.
application_fee: The fee is paid by Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or by internet banking of any Bank, and the payment mode must be opted for up to the closing date/time. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected, and no representation is entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance and cannot be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
selection_process: Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of the information in their online applications and their performance in the Recruitment Test (RT), if held. The stages in order are: || Shortlisting based on the online application, with a Recruitment Test if held. || Interview. || If applications are large, the Commission may restrict the number called for interview by desirable qualification, higher qualification, higher experience, counting experience before or after the essential qualification, invoking experience even where none is prescribed, or by holding a Recruitment Test. || Minimum suitability in the interview, out of 100 marks: UR-50, OBC-45, SC/ST/PH-40. || Where an RT is followed by an interview, a candidate must reach the minimum suitability for the category at both stages. The RT minimum is decided by the Commission case to case. || The date of the interview, for which shortlisted candidates bring the print-out of the online application and other documents, will be intimated separately. || If a Recruitment Test forms part of selection, it will ordinarily be held at Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi and Visakhapatnam. The list is subject to change.
